response_contract.scientific_semantics: Storm Events details rows are reported EVENT_ID records, grouped by EPISODE_ID; fatalities and locations are one-to-many child tables keyed to EVENT_ID and MUST NOT be naively joined before summing parent damage or event counts. Dates use source-specific local timezone codes; reported geographic units can be counties, forecast zones or marine zones. Historical event-type coverage and event submission/reporting standards change over time; missing reports do not imply zero hazard. DAMAGE_PROPERTY and DAMAGE_CROPS are reported event estimates, NOT policyholder insured losses, gross/net claims or validated TIV. Already executed 2024 original-source relational audit in docs/research/executed-source-findings-20261103.md found 3 parent-level fatality-count contradictions and up to 72x naive child-join multiplication; these are blocking scientific review findings, not grounds for silently discarding or repairing source events. This documentation-only contract does NOT establish CAT event frequency, hail/wind intensity, physics, commercial use or model admission.
